comment: PROPOSAL for the end-game cinematic (openspec/changes/endgame-cinematic). Not read by tools/comms_pipeline.py and not referenced at runtime. Two lists. `cinematic`: the scene's exclusive lines; no radio trigger may ever play them; `chain` is the audio chain (`radio>room` starts with the radio effect and loses it at the cut, `room` has none); `echoes` names a radio line whose words the line answers. `plants`: radio lines that set the reveal up; fields follow art/comms/lines.json (trigger = GameEvent name, speaker = cast id, emotion; brood lines carry grunt, gloss and say); `set` is `first` (eligible from the first run) or `second` (eligible only after the ending has been seen on the device); `ledger` lists rows of plan/endgame-reveal-ledger.md; `payoff` is the shot. When the voice-stack change admits an engine, append the accepted plants to lines.json under their trigger (never reorder existing clips) with the `plant` and `set` fields that change adds to the schema. All phrasing is original. Speaker picks follow ledger decisions D1 (Gorrak is 'the General') and D2 (Vexxa is the cadet); if the operator picks other characters, only the speaker ids change.

cinematic.speaker: admiral
cinematic.text: Overwatch to squadron. Carrier's down. All wings… come home.
cinematic.direction: The last two words are hers, not the Admiral's: softer, closer, no radio.

cinematic.speaker: ulgra
cinematic.text: No way. You rolled a six again?
cinematic.direction: A kid's real voice. The first brood line ever heard plainly.

cinematic.speaker: morth
cinematic.text: A rematch. After a short break.
cinematic.direction: He growls the first two words in his monster voice, then finishes as himself.

cinematic.speaker: vexxa
cinematic.text: Refills for the fleet. On the house.

cinematic.speaker: vexxa
cinematic.direction: Stage whisper, a nod at the counter. This line starts the rack focus.

cinematic.speaker: gorrak
cinematic.text: Order up, table five! Smile, everybody. It's a beautiful day!
cinematic.direction: Booming and delighted. Everything the Marshal's growl was not.

cinematic.speaker: admiral
cinematic.direction: A beat first. The smile she never shows on the radio.

cinematic.speaker: vexxa
cinematic.direction: Off screen, to the plastic figure.

plants.speaker: admiral
plants.text: Last ship, pilot. Then we pack up. Make it a good one.

plants.speaker: admiral
plants.text: Sun's getting low on the Carrier. One more, then home.

plants.speaker: vexxa
plants.gloss: Fine. That one is on the house.
plants.say: Fine. That one is on the house.

plants.speaker: vexxa
plants.gloss: Empty already? I just topped you up!
plants.say: Empty already? I just topped you up!

plants.speaker: vexxa
plants.gloss: Sit still, little ship. I am carrying a full tray.
plants.say: Sit still, little ship. I am carrying a full tray.

plants.speaker: rook
plants.text: The General sounds grumpy today. Somebody smile at him.
plants.note: Only after a Gorrak line. The owner answers it in endgame.e8.

plants.speaker: sunny
plants.text: Krybor! I hear the General runs a tidy place.

plants.speaker: gorrak
plants.gloss: My house, my rules. And wipe your feet!
plants.say: My house, my rules. And wipe your feet!

plants.speaker: gorrak
plants.gloss: Fine. Keep the corner. You are good for business.
plants.say: Fine. Keep the corner. You are good for business.

plants.speaker: skarn
plants.gloss: Order up! I mean, wings up!
plants.say: Order up! I mean, wings up!

plants.speaker: pip
plants.text: Count the dots! Did I roll that? I rolled that!

plants.speaker: sunny
plants.text: Forecast for Ember Moon: sizzling, with a chance of onions.

plants.speaker: lindqvist
plants.text: Beacon is buzzing, Overwatch. I think our number is up.

plants.speaker: voss
plants.text: Careful. One good wave and this whole place washes out.

plants.speaker: kessler
plants.text: It's the sand again! Who parks a rig on a beach?

plants.speaker: sliss
plants.gloss: Quiet. The big one under the table is asleep.
plants.say: Quiet. The big one under the table is asleep.

plants.speaker: nomad
plants.text: Light rain, right on the hour. You could set a watch by it.
plants.note: New trigger; the event exists in lib/game/game_events.dart.

plants.speaker: skritch
plants.gloss: One fry! I only took one fry!
plants.say: One fry! I only took one fry!

plants.speaker: morth
plants.gloss: Five rounds. Good game. Same table next week?
plants.say: Five rounds. Good game. Same table next week?

plants.speaker: vexxa
plants.gloss: Back again? I kept your corner.
plants.say: Back again? I kept your corner.

plants.speaker: gorrak
plants.gloss: You again! The usual, I suppose?
plants.say: You again! The usual, I suppose?

plants.speaker: admiral
plants.text: Overwatch to squadron. I said one more turn. One.
plants.note: Answers endgame.e11. Sector 1 of a new campaign only.

plants.speaker: pip
plants.text: Best of five? Best of seven? I can do this all day!

plants.speaker: nomad
plants.text: Funny. I'd swear I have flown this exact afternoon before.

plants.speaker: rook
plants.text: Topped up! Tell the cadet she's my favourite enemy.
